title: manuscript-guard summary of a run on the data held in the vault
description: What `manuscript-guard vault run` tells the agent, at .manuscript-guard/vault/last-run.json in the project: each script's exit code and, where one failed, the class of a Python exception, the frames of the traceback that fall in the project's own files (path, line, function), the function names of R's `Calls:` line, and the key of a KeyError where it is a column name the released profile or the data dictionary already holds. No message and no value: every name kept is one the project's code or a released file already shows, and the rest is left out (DESIGN.md, the vault, Known gaps: an exit code and a line number still carry a few bits a script could choose).

exit_code.description: null for the script a run was stopped in.

stopped.description: The run was stopped before its end, by a fault or a Ctrl-C. What it moved before then may wait in the outbox (`outbox`), and the run is not one to release.

class.description: A built-in exception's name: no other class is named.

exception.description: The exception is not a built-in one; its name, and its module, are withheld.

outbox.description: Whether files the run wrote wait in the vault's outbox. Only a run that finished can be released; a stopped one's files wait there unreleased.
